definitions.explanation: A small, sweet citrus fruit with easy-to-peel skin. A winter staple in Japan.

notes:
みかん (also written {蜜柑|みかん}) is the most common citrus fruit in Japan.

CULTURE:
Eating みかん while warming up under a ⟦こたつ→炬燵：05070_kotatsu⟧ (heated table) is a classic Japanese winter tradition. They are in season from November to February. ⟦{愛媛県|えひめけん}→愛媛県：noentry⟧ and ⟦{和歌山県|わかやまけん}→和歌山県：noentry⟧ are famous production areas.
